verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented bulk-operation capability, such as bulk-editing, archiving or updating many gates or experiments in one action. What exists is adjacent only: batch evaluation of several gates for one user, multi-event logging, Layers that group experiments, and a CRUD Console API and CLI that a developer could script against. None of these is a product-level bulk operation, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
